skill.name: bamboohr-automation
skill.description: Guide BambooHR employee, time-off, benefit, dependent, and profile workflows through the Rube MCP integration.
skill.summary: Operate common BambooHR workflows through Rube MCP with schema discovery and workflow-specific safeguards.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The 45 command-execution alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, and the four reconnaissance alerts describe normal BambooHR lookups or permission notes. The external MCP endpoint is a real network dependency, while sensitive HR access and unconfirmed write workflows create significant contextual risk.

remediation.issue: Employee and time-off mutations can run without explicit confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation immediately before each write. Show the employee, current value, proposed value, request status, and affected dates.

remediation.issue: Workflows can retrieve highly sensitive employee and dependent data.
remediation.suggestion: Use least-privilege BambooHR roles, request only necessary fields, redact outputs, and prohibit storing sensitive responses in logs or prompts.

remediation.issue: BambooHR operations are routed through an external MCP endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Document the trust boundary, verify the endpoint and authorization flow, and disclose how Rube processes or retains BambooHR data.

static_findings.snippet: - Active BambooHR connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `bamboohr`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
2. `BAMBOOHR_GET_EMPLOYEE` - Get detailed info for a specific employee [Optional]
- `fields`: Comma-separated list of fields to return (e.g., 'firstName,lastName,department,jobTitle'
- The `fields` parameter controls which fields are returned; omitting it may return minimal data
- Inactive/terminated employees may be included; check `status` field
- `since`: ISO 8601 datetime string for change detection threshold
- `since` parameter is required; use ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T00:00:00Z')
- Field-value pairs for the fields to update (e.g., `department`, `jobTitle`, `workPhone`)
- Response data may be nested under `data` key
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Verify current values with GET_EMPLOYEE before updating to avoid overwriting
- Some operations require admin or manager-level access

content.value_statement: Manual BambooHR lookups and updates consume HR time and increase consistency risks. This skill guides structured workflows through Rube MCP with current tool discovery.
actual_capabilities: Lists employees and retrieves selected employee details.
Finds employee changes since an ISO 8601 timestamp.
Checks time-off types, balances, and requests.
Creates or updates time-off requests when authorized.
Reads dependent and benefit coverage information.
Updates supported employee fields after checking current values.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active authorized BambooHR connection.
Available fields and actions depend on BambooHR permissions and plan features.
Tool schemas can change and must be discovered before each workflow.
The skill does not replace organizational approval or privacy controls.

use_cases.title: Review employee records
use_cases.description: Find an employee and retrieve only the fields needed for an HR support request.

use_cases.title: Manage leave requests
use_cases.description: Check balances, prepare a leave request, and confirm any authorized status change.

use_cases.title: Monitor employee changes
use_cases.description: Identify changed employee records since the last synchronization timestamp for downstream processing.

prompt_templates.title: Find an employee
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [employee name] in BambooHR. Return their department, job title, work email, and employment status only.

prompt_templates.title: Check leave availability
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the [leave type] balance for [employee]. Resolve the employee and leave type IDs first. Do not create a request.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a profile update
prompt_templates.prompt: Read [employee] and prepare changing [field] from its current value to [new value]. Ask for confirmation before updating BambooHR.

prompt_templates.title: Run an incremental change review
prompt_templates.prompt: Find employee records changed since [ISO 8601 timestamp]. Retrieve [approved fields], summarize differences, and exclude sensitive fields from the output.

output_examples.input: Find Jordan Lee and show department, job title, work email, and status.
output_examples.output: Jordan Lee was found. Department: Finance. Job title: Senior Analyst. Work email: jordan.lee@example.com. Status: Active.

output_examples.input: Prepare changing Casey Morgan's work phone to 555-0142.
output_examples.output: Casey Morgan currently has work phone 555-0108. Proposed value: 555-0142. Confirmation is required before updating BambooHR.

output_examples.input: Check Sam Patel's vacation balance and prepare a request for September 14 through September 16.
output_examples.output: Vacation balance is 64 hours. The proposed request covers three days. No request was submitted because confirmation is still required.

best_practices: Discover current tool schemas before supplying parameters.
Request the minimum employee fields needed for the task.
Confirm the target and proposed changes before every write operation.
anti_patterns: Do not retrieve full employee or dependent records without a defined need.
Do not approve leave or update employee data from ambiguous requests.
Do not expose BambooHR responses in shared logs or unrelated prompts.

faq.question: What is required before using this skill?
faq.answer: Configure Rube MCP, authenticate an authorized BambooHR connection, and confirm that the connection is active.

faq.question: Can it update employee information?
faq.answer: Yes. It can update supported fields when BambooHR permissions allow the action and the user confirms the exact change.

faq.question: Can it approve time-off requests?
faq.answer: It can update request status for authorized manager or administrator accounts. Organizational approval rules still apply.

faq.question: How does it protect sensitive data?
faq.answer: The workflow should request minimal fields, use least-privilege access, redact outputs, and avoid logging employee or dependent data.

faq.question: Why must tools be searched first?
faq.answer: Rube and BambooHR schemas can change. Tool discovery provides current names, parameters, and response structures.

faq.question: Does it support employee synchronization?
faq.answer: It can find records changed since a timestamp and retrieve selected details. External storage and update processing require separate systems.
